PHP 8.4+ only. Add `declare(strict_types=1);` to every PHP file. Make all classes final unless inheritance is required. Use readonly properties wherever possible, constructor property promotion, typed properties/return types, PSR-12. Never use `var_dump()` or `dd()` in production code. Base: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk`; Data: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk.Data`; Requests: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk\Requests`; Enums: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk\Enums`. DTOs are `final readonly`; Requests are `final`, extend `Saloon\Http\Request`; backed enums. Member-only requests must use `RequiresMemberAuth` trait. All responses typed using Data DTOs. Run: `composer test`, `composer lint`, `composer test:unit`, `composer test:types`, `composer refactor`. Use traits, typed-array DocBlocks. POST/PUT/DELETE or member data/DOI modifications require:
`use VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk\Traits\Requests\RequiresMemberAuth;`
`use RequiresMemberAuth;`
`protected Method $method = Method::POST;`
